blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Benedicto College Cheetahs pulled off a major upset, beating the defending champions University of the Visayas (UV) Green Lancers, 64-55, in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament on Thursday, October 8, at the Cebu Coliseum. Coming in as underdogs, the Cheetahs never backed down as they completed the first round of eliminations with a near-perfect 7-1 (win-loss) record to take the top spot in the team standings.
